items.source: Initiates a graceful shutdown of the web server. Handling of new requests is prevented and the given callback is invoked at the end of the attempt. The attempt can be explicitly ended by invoking stop(). The default implementation invokes the callback immediately with GracefulShutdownResult.IMMEDIATE, i.e. no attempt is made at a graceful shutdown.
items.translation: 启动 Web 服务器的优雅关闭。阻止处理新请求，并在尝试结束时调用给定的 callback。可以通过调用 stop() 显式结束该尝试。默认实现会立即使用 GracefulShutdownResult.IMMEDIATE 调用回调，即不进行优雅关闭的尝试。

items.source: Simple interface that represents a fully configured web server (for example Tomcat, Jetty, Netty). Allows the server to be started and stopped.
items.translation: 表示完全配置的 Web 服务器（例如 Tomcat、Jetty、Netty）的简单接口。允许启动和停止该服务器：started 和 stopped。

items.source: Destroys the web server such that it cannot be started again.
items.translation: 销毁 Web 服务器，使其无法再次启动。

items.source: Return the port this server is listening on.
items.translation: 返回此服务器监听的端口。

items.source: WebServerException - if the server cannot be started
items.translation: WebServerException - 如果无法启动服务器

items.source: WebServerException - if the server cannot be stopped
items.translation: WebServerException - 如果无法停止服务器

items.source: Initiates a graceful shutdown of the web server.
items.translation: 启动 Web 服务器的优雅关闭。

items.source:
Starts the web server. Calling this method on an already started server has no
effect.
items.translation: 启动 Web 服务器。在已启动的服务器上调用此方法没有任何效果。

items.source:
Stops the web server. Calling this method on an already stopped server has no
effect.
items.translation: 停止 Web 服务器。对已停止的服务器调用此方法没有效果。

items.source: callback - the callback to invoke when the graceful shutdown completes
items.translation: callback - 优雅关闭完成时调用的回调
